randomizer.config.category.general.toolt: Core settings for the randomizer (delay, weights, toggles).
randomizer.config.category.content.toolt: Control which items, mobs and effects can be used.
randomizer.config.category.effects.toolt: Configure duration and strength of status effects.
randomizer.config.category.mobs.tooltip: Configure mob spawn counts and radius.
randomizer.config.category.hud.tooltip: Randomizer timer HUD position and visibility.
randomizer.config.hud.disableHud.tooltip: If enabled, the Randomizer timer will not be displayed.
randomizer.config.hud.hudX.tooltip: Controls where the timer is displayed horizontally on your screen.
randomizer.config.hud.hudY.tooltip: Controls where the timer is displayed vertically on your screen.
randomizer.config.category.display.toolt: Visual settings for the HUD and the boss bar.
Shows a boss bar that fills up until the next random event.
randomizer.config.display.showHudWithBos: If disabled, only the boss bar is used and the HUD timer text is hidden.
randomizer.config.general.delaySeconds.t: Time in seconds between random events.
randomizer.config.general.enableItems.to: If enabled, the Randomizer may give random items.
If enabled, random potion effects may be applied.
randomizer.config.general.enableMobs.too: If enabled, random mobs can spawn near a player.
randomizer.config.general.weightItems.to: Higher weight increases the chance for item rewards.
Higher weight increases the chance for effects.
randomizer.config.general.weightMobs.too: Higher weight increases the chance for mob spawns.
randomizer.config.content.onlyVanillaIte: If enabled, only minecraft: items are used.
randomizer.config.content.onlyVanillaMob: If enabled, only minecraft: mobs are used.
randomizer.config.content.onlyVanillaEff: If enabled, only minecraft: potion effects are used.
randomizer.config.content.enableHostileM: If enabled, monsters like zombies and skeletons can spawn.
randomizer.config.content.enablePassiveM: If enabled, passive animals can spawn.
randomizer.config.mobs.baseHostileMobCou: Base amount of hostile mobs per event.
randomizer.config.mobs.basePassiveMobCou: Base amount of passive mobs per event.
randomizer.config.mobs.baseHostileRadius: Distance hostile mobs spawn from the player.
randomizer.config.mobs.basePassiveRadius: Distance passive mobs spawn from the player.
randomizer.config.effects.durationMinFac: Minimum multiplier relative to base duration.
randomizer.config.effects.durationMaxFac: Maximum multiplier relative to base duration.
